name: RITES Limited
summary: RITES Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an engineering consultancy company in the field of railways, highways, airports, ports, ropeways, urban transport, and inland waterways. The company operates through five segments: Consultancy Services; Leasing of Railway Rolling Stock & Equipments; Export of Rolling Stock, Equipments and Spares; Turnkey Construction Projects; and Power Generation.
